question: Which structure beyond degrees carries the end of growth with closings anywhere: degrees (SW), degrees with each knot's youngest distinction (R2), the youngest alone (R2p), or the growth's schedule (FULL)?

definitions.endings: OLD-CORE-20261112-001A-E001's X(0.25), X(0.3), X(0.35) endings regenerated from its seeds, its pilot's twelve held out.
definitions.rungs: SW, R2 (switch chains, 20 x knots steps, rejections counted), R2p, FULL; 20 resamples each; shares ending and shares identical in pair counts.
definitions.fairness: exact transition matrices of SW and R2 on every simple pattern of five degree sequences: symmetric, connected within preserved classes.
definitions.control: Q0: one Pasch trade where one exists keeps pair counts and allows no state.

public_inputs.code: census.py (sha256 1f08fb5c5da61e2e7afe91ed9ec111b2ffb9a8ee275135fa358d8d9283db9f1f) beside this file; OLD-CORE's census.py (sha256 ec68b970ab4eb1203eda55b27346d7a7dac126cd2f7b04d26170b72f3a1495b7) and fates.py (sha256 72d3571ed66dddaa6c517b3ce29ce14ae72c008c025669e2ef071b77b73eba35); pysat; numpy.
public_inputs.run: census.py from the repository root, then census.py --summary; output artifacts/AGE-NEST-20261112-001A/AGE-NEST-20261112-001A-E001_resample_ladder/.

forbidden_inputs: Changing endings, rungs, steps, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: Per setting: medians of the four shares, the share of cores where R2 exceeds SW, forced shares.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Q0, the pair-count lemma; the fairness matrices.

predictions.N1: median P_SW <= 0.1 in X(0.3) and X(0.35)
predictions.N2: median P_R2 >= 0.2 and R2 > SW in >= 70% of untied cores, both settings

decision_rules.N1 and N2 hold: the end is carried by how knots nest by age (the counts among the oldest j), not by degrees
decision_rules.N2 fails: the nesting does not suffice; the schedule (FULL) or more is needed

stop_rule: One run and its summary; a hand-off to the referee thread; report.
runtime: About fifteen minutes on eight workers; systemd-run --user -p MemoryMax=8G -p MemorySwapMax=0.
